test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_small_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS n, concat('user', toString(cityHash64(number) % 100000000), '@example.com') AS s, concat('name', toString(cityHash64(number) % 20000)) AS d FROM numbers(50000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_max_dictionary_size = {max_dictionary_size}, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT s FROM file('test_parquet_small_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) FORMAT Null
SELECT d FROM file('test_parquet_small_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) FORMAT Null
SELECT s, d FROM file('test_parquet_small_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE n % 1000 = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT n FROM file('test_parquet_small_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) WHERE s = 'user12345678@example.com' SETTINGS input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT n FROM file('test_parquet_small_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) WHERE d = 'name12345' SETTINGS input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0 FORMAT Null
